name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 42
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1p. Expresses deep concern over the sanctions imposed by the United States Government on the UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territories occupied since 1967, Francesca Albanese; calls on the Commission and the EU Member States to take action to safeguard her physical integrity and allow her to carry out her duties independently and without any external pressure;
